name: Cable Seated Alternating Row
steps: Sit tall at a low cable row station with knees slightly bent and feet braced against the footplates.
Hold one handle in each hand with both arms extended forward and shoulders set back.
Drive one elbow behind you to pull that handle toward your waist while the opposite arm stays extended.
Extend the working arm forward under control and alternate sides.
tips: Keep both shoulders facing the pulleys without twisting your torso.
Keep your chest lifted and avoid rocking backward to pull the handle.
